scope: Lightweight extensible Python Agent Harness; coding and CLI are default applications. Natural-language plugins, frozen benchmarks and complete failed/cancelled trajectories remain; distillation and training code are removed.

capabilities.core: One model/tool loop, permission checks, context, cancellation and Journal; no workspace, coding components, Node, YAML or model SDK required on import.
capabilities.coding: Optional tasks/repository/skills/hooks/mcp/checkpoints; selected tool construction, bounded parallel batches, background commands and file mutation reservations.
capabilities.defaults: Host full-access + never. No independent intent routing, full inventory, automatic checkpoints, mandatory completion gate or cumulative Harness budget.
capabilities.plugins: Explicit trusted PluginHost; tools, services, providers, hooks, children and completion checks. Fixed independent acceptance and portable delivery require rechecking in the new environment.
capabilities.evaluation: Official task images, frozen conditions, independent grader. New normal/strict policy is explicit; missing historical field retains strict.
capabilities.trajectories: Journal-only default; complete model/tool facts and partial failures. Offline ATIF/OpenAI messages exports; no training or distillation framework.
capabilities.legacy: Old RPC/SQLite and history readers remain opt-in; modern worker/runtime/benchmark code does not import the old control plane.

last_verified_baseline.scope: All six CI jobs, minimal SDK and second-environment plugin checks, real installed Windows terminal/resize/cancel smoke. No paid model calls or existing project ACL changes.

release_validation.local_checks: Version/provenance, CLI and session regression; quality/contracts; document references and source excerpts; fresh wheel and second-environment SDK/plugin delivery passed.
release_validation.scope: CI acceptance belongs to the exact commit/tag workflow run. Historical baseline checks do not certify new source; local checks do not imply remote CI passed.

historical_release_evidence.archived_report: EVALUATION_SUMMARY_20260813.md at report_commit; historical protocol also remains in benchmark/harbor/README.md

aider_polyglot.reported_model_execution: live provider via local proxy according to contemporaneous report; raw trial records not found in current checkout
aider_polyglot.reported_raw_result: 211/225 = 93.78% final verifier reward, including one infrastructure error in denominator
aider_polyglot.reported_protocol: One permitted same-session verifier-feedback repair; concurrency one, Harbor infrastructure max_retries three, setup timeout multiplier twelve and installation retries eight. Not single-attempt pass@1.
aider_polyglot.missing_evidence: Historical summary.json, job result.json, 225 trial/verifier/trajectory records and per-trial staged source or immutable source manifest. Release a9f290f includes post-run fixes and is not proof of the code bytes used during evaluation.
aider_polyglot.use: May cite as explicitly attributed historical v0.1.1 report under its two-attempt protocol. Do not present as reproduced/current accuracy, current native task completion rate, or a measured improvement without original evidence.

regression_448.source: Contemporaneous v0.1.1 report records 448 passed and uv lock --check after post-run fixes
regression_448.use: Historical reported count only; not current-source acceptance, model API validation or proof of the 225-task result. Current acceptance is identified by CI commit/run and scoped native evidence.

historical_work.boundary: Previous native/live experiments retain their exact source, authorization, budget, attempts and results. No automatic rerun or transfer of old model authorization.

remaining_work: Full native OS read/network/hard-resource isolation and macOS native ownership integration remain unverified optional extensions.
Domain-specific Personal/Robot integrations and new-model/public benchmark scores need their own evidence.
npm/PyPI registry publication is separate from the source release/tag; no registry publication is implied.
verification_policy: Separate deterministic checks, native platform acceptance, packaged installation and paid model experiments. Logs stay under ignored .local/implementation or CI artifacts; never replace missing evidence with inferred success.
